headline: Ivanti KEV deadline tomorrow; CVSS 10.0 LXD and MicroCloud flaw; FBI ties $6.43B Binance heist to TraderTraitor

bullets.text: New since the last SITREP: hackers stole about $2.7 million from Polymarket traders through a hijacked DebugBear script.

Attackers are chaining three Ivanti Connect Secure flaws (CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527) to gain unauthenticated root access. The first CISA KEV due date for Ivanti Connect Secure is tomorrow, 2026-11-02; the second is 2026-11-13.
A CVSS 10.0 flaw in LXD and MicroCloud lets attackers impersonate trusted clients without a private key.
KEV due dates for the exploited GitLab CE/EE flaw CVE-2026-97229 and the Cisco ASA/FTD flaw CVE-2026-76418 fall today, 2026-11-01. Treat any unpatched instances as overdue.
The FBI has linked North Korea's TraderTraitor group to the record Binance crypto heist, now put at $6.43 billion. Binance earlier tied the theft to a compromised DevOps laptop.
The official Claude Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace was trojanized with a persistent SSH backdoor; WIRED reports malicious Claude extensions reached thousands of devices.

actions: Patch Ivanti Connect Secure before the 2026-11-02 KEV deadline and check appliances for signs of the chained root compromise.
Find any LXD and MicroCloud deployments, check the vendor advisory for the CVSS 10.0 flaw, and patch them.
If GitLab CE/EE (CVE-2026-97229) or Cisco ASA/FTD (CVE-2026-76418) are still unpatched, treat them as overdue and patch now.
Update Drupal Commerce Core for the actively exploited CVE-2026-118539 and check sites for unauthorized access.
If developers use the Claude Code extension in Cursor, check it against the vendor advisory and look for unexpected SSH keys or services.
If you store AI provider API keys in Northflank, rotate them and review provider usage and billing for abuse.
